author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,
finally I made a new map for the new Avicade gamemode Chroma.
This is also my first Contest map.

Arlet

Title: Arlet
Created By: resepignev
Game: Chroma (Avicade)
Teams: Blue, Green, Red and Yellow
Details: Two layer map with teleport points. The teleport points are at the spikes, if you walk over them, you'll teleported from the bottom up to the top and from the top layer to the bottom one.
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/pvr60h2pca604b3/Arlet.zip
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/LrfCh
YML: http://pastebin.com/gu6FPHT2
Screenshots:
